title: 3D Black Bio RNA Extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (v4.0.0 or later), Magnetic Module GEN2, P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette, Opentrons 200 µL filter tips (recommended) or 300 µL tips, NEST 96‑Deep Well Plate (2 mL), NEST 96‑Well PCR Plate, NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL), NEST 1‑Well Reservoir (195 mL), Opentrons 96‑Well Aluminum Block, PCR tubes, and the 3D Black Bio RNA Extraction Kit.

steps.title: Prepare samples in source plate
steps.instruction: Place at least 200 µL of each sample into a standard 96‑well plate; this plate will serve as the source for the automated extraction.

steps.title: Download the protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the 3D Black Bio RNA Extraction protocol file from the vendor’s website or repository.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App and upload the downloaded protocol file into the application.

steps.title: Set up deck according to deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing the magnetic module, deep‑well plate, PCR plate, reservoirs, tip racks, and aluminum block in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App calibration routine, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette.

steps.title: Run the automated extraction
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App; the robot will process up to 96 samples (any multiple of 8 up to 96) and dispense 60 µL of RNA eluate into the 96‑well PCR plate, ready for downstream RT/qPCR, sequencing, or hybridization.
